purpose: Bounded tool-value diagnosis for HCL base-agent construction, not autonomous qualification or HCL efficacy.
hypothesis: Question-conditioned CheXagent evidence can provide useful task information that broad pathology probabilities omit; measure gains and harmful changes against the same unseeded agent.
selection: Seed20261025 metadata-only unique single-image case category balancing; all selected files must be single-frame. No question, answer or explanation used for selection.
order: Rotate A/B/C, B/C/A, C/A/B per case. Fresh graph/state each arm.

decision.question_conditioned_headroom: C correct >= A correct +2, at least10/12 successful expert seeds, all36 completed and vision payload present in every planner call. Descriptive development criterion only; report paired gains/losses and costs.
decision.if_no_headroom: Close local MedRAX tool-evidence adaptation route; do not repeat prompt/tool search or launch HCL on these failed gates. Select a scientifically distinct feasible route using retained negatives and existing authorization.
decision.if_headroom: Use only as evidence to design a separately frozen autonomous shared-agent qualification; forced seeds never satisfy prior native gates or authorize efficacy claims.

scoring: Exact final standalone A-F or final explicit Answer: A-F; otherwise abstention/wrong. Answer and explanation never enter model/tool context. Score after all episodes. All 36 remain denominator, including load/runtime/format/budget failures.
direct_preflight: Reuse v1 assets/runtime; CPU canonical-image and causal-arm checks before inference.
gold_boundary: Only question and canonical image paths reach planner/tools. Score all36 after generation, full denominator including errors/notrun.
input_policy: Decode original single frame with PIL, convert RGB, save PNG once per case under this new run. All arms and tools use identical canonical file; original preserved. Verify dimensions and RGB pixels once.
forced_evidence: B and C execute one fixed seed call via unchanged native Agent.execute_tools before normal workflow. C prompt is exact question including choices. Count seed toward tool/episode budgets; tag seed separately from autonomous calls. Seed is a causal intervention, not a planner choice.
